title: PHP 7.2.32 Released!
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 7.2.32. This is a security release impacting the of PHP. official Windows builds

For windows users running an official build, this release contains a patched version of addressing . libcurlCVE-2020-8169

For all other consumers of PHP, this release is functionally identical to PHP 7.2.31 and no upgrade from that point release is necessary.
